ruleDefinitions.name: Launch Agent/Daemon Execution Via Launchctl
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of programs as Launch Agents or Launch Daemons using launchctl on macOS.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/launchctl$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*submit.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*load.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*start.*")))
